label: Invariant set-up: the giver's set-up is the same at every accessible world where it exists
definition: SetupInvariantAt F A w y: for every world v accessible from w (frame access of the shared CausalityFrame) at which y exists, SetupSameIn A y w v.
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred (docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md). The frame surrogate for a simple (no varying intrinsic state) and patientless (no varying external condition) source. Examples: an immutable being with no patient, on the classical theist reading of God (the decree is not a varying intrinsic state; its terminus is an extrinsic denomination). Non-examples: a die (initial conditions vary); an agent who changes its mind; a theist reading on which divine decrees are contingent intrinsic states (that reading denies invariance). Invariance does not imply one power (the intellectual-chancer model).
